ambiguities_or_notes: The source’s telegraphic sequence of biblical and Talmudic cross-references is preserved without reconciling citations to modern editions.
Горохол[ьский] is transliterated as “Gorokholsky,” retaining the source form rather than silently normalizing the street name.
The source phrase песок Израиля is rendered literally as “sand of Israel.”

The shorthand реке is represented as the biblical/Talmudic expression “raca” in the note about liability to the Sanhedrin; the surrounding reference makes the allusion identifiable, while the fragmentary syntax is retained.
Гомилетика. Патристика. Литургика. is preserved as three bare disciplinary labels.
